changes.summary: Window-movement time after ignition off rises from 45 s to 60 s, still ending early if a front door opens. The 60 s value matches the deleted WLC-023, so WLC-023's intent is carried here.
The trigger changes from a rain-sensor input to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The close runs in express mode with anti-pinch active. Rain-driven closing is no longer specified.
The pinch detection threshold drops from 100 N to 80 N. Detection is more sensitive, which raises the risk of false reversals.
The minimum reversal after a pinch rises from 125 mm to 150 mm, or to fully open if that is less. The 10 ms stop requirement is unchanged.
'set itself to' is reworded as 'set its state to'. The behaviour is the same.
The undefined 'reduce to a safe value' becomes a defined trigger (estimated temperature above 130 °C) and a defined limit (15 A).
The WLC_Status period halves from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. Bus load and queue timing change.

The stop-motor and set-fault-state actions move out to the new WLC-037 and WLC-038. The DTC storage condition (more than 25 A for more than 50 ms) is unchanged. Net behaviour is the same, but the trace responsibilities move.

new_pass_criteria.limit: allowed for 60 s after ignition off

tests.new_procedure: With the window half open, send the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. This replaces the rain signal. Observe the close mode and the anti-pinch state during the close.
tests.reason: The rain-signal trigger no longer exists in WLC-012, so the procedure and criteria must change to the CAN request.

tests.new_procedure: At 13.5 V and 23 °C, express close onto the 10 N/mm pinch rod placed at 100 mm. Record force, stop time and reversal distance. After the reversal, command express close within 2 s and confirm it is inhibited. Note: the requirement gives 'within 10 ms' with no reference point; align the reference with the test.

added.pass_criteria: After B1A02 is stored, the motor is stopped. The requirement gives no time limit, so none is added.
After B1A02 is stored, the fault state in WLC_Status is set. The requirement gives no time limit, so none is added.
After a pinch reversal, express close is inhibited for 2 s.

concerns.concern: The 100 µA limit came from the deleted WLC-032. Unless WLC-004 still states it, the test has no source for its limit. Confirm before rerunning, or reinstate the requirement.

WLC-018 was vague and untestable, so deleting it is reasonable. But TC-AP-09 is now orphaned. Write a measurable replacement, such as no false reversal under the rough-road profile, so the test stays traceable.
TC-AP-09 is not traced to WLC-014, but it must be rerun at 80 N under LL-2021. Add the WLC-014 trace.
These are affected by the 80 N threshold and the 150 mm reversal but are not traced to WLC-014 or WLC-015. Rerun them. TC-AP-08 (repeated pinch lockout) is also affected by the WLC-039 inhibit.
Cold plus low voltage is the worst case for pinch stop time (LL-2022). Run it on every release, not only at the end of the program.
WLC-039 inhibits express close for 2 s after a reversal, which may affect express start, express stop and express close conditions. Check and rerun if needed.
The rain-sensor function now has no requirement. Confirm whether the input still exists. TC-MV-08 may depend on the express-close trigger, which is now the CAN request.
The test relies on the thermal estimate, which must be current (LL-2024-01). The platform thermal module is shared with WLC-200, so confirm the fix is present in this build before running it.
These are not traced to WLC-025 but use the same thermal estimate. Check whether they reference the 130 °C limit and rerun if so.
The cycle halves to 50 ms, so repeat the worst-case queue calculation (LL-2024-09). Run the test on a loaded bus, including a diagnostic session, not only a quiet bus.
WLC-037 adds a motor-stop response to B1A02, but no timing is given. Check whether the diagnostic response-time requirement applies and ask the specification owner for a limit.
The test only checks one case above both limits. Consider a negative case below 25 A or 50 ms to confirm the storage boundary, now that the stop and fault actions are in separate requirements.

Not affected by this change, but LL-2023 requires a test that removes the Hall sensor during actuation at the lowest supply voltage. Confirm TC-DG-01 does this. Its fault path should also use the WLC-038 fault state consistently.
WLC-035 covers climatic operation, which includes the cold and hot pinch tests. Check whether TC-EN-01 includes pinch and rerun it at 80 N if so.
If a usability criterion is still wanted, write a measurable requirement. Retiring the test removes the only usability check.
The software-process requirement is deleted and has no traced test. Confirm that the process obligation is covered by the project plan, so the audit link is not lost.
WLC-023 is deleted, and its 60 s value now sits in WLC-007. Confirm the intent is the same, since the front-door condition is now part of WLC-007.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
